title: FYI Yachts’ Alexandra Tovar Sets Sail on TheGolden Bachelor
description: Alexandra Tovar of FYI Yachts stars on The Golden Bachelor Season 2—celebrating luxury yachting, adventure, and Miami elegance.
html:
We are delighted to share that Alexandra Tovar, one of our Top yacht consultants at FYI Yachts, will be featured as a contestant on season 2 of ABC’s The Golden Bachelor. She is known for her elegance, adventurous spirit, and dedication to yachting.

FYI Yachts: A Symbol of Luxury Lifestyle

At FYI Yachts, we don’t just sell yachts; We embrace a lifestyle of sophistication, exclusivity, and adventure. Alexandra has long been an ambassador of this vision, guiding clients to discover vessels that reflect their personal style and aspirations.

Our consultants, like Alexandra, ensure every detail that aligns with the luxury lifestyle our clients deserve. Now, as she steps onto a new stage, she carries the same spirit of confidence and elegance that defines FYI Yachts.

About The Golden Bachelor Season 2

Premiering Wednesday, September 24, 2025, on ABC, The Golden Bachelor introduces viewers to a cast of inspiring women searching for love later in life. Alexandra, at 67 and based in Miami, Florida, brings her dynamic personality, zest for life, and luxury expertise into the spotlight.

Her story, from raising three children to building a thriving career in yachting, showcases the adventurous, bold, and refined lifestyle that resonates with our global clientele.

Alexandra’s World Beyond Yachting

Alexandra’s life is filled with passion and movement. She jogs eight miles each morning, travels the world, and fills her nights with music and dancing. A proud Colombian at heart, she cheers passionately for her national soccer team and finds joy in the rhythms of Bob Marley.

Her genuine spirit and a vibrant passion for life reflect the same qualities that make FYI Yachts truly special beyond just being a company. We are a community of dreamers, voyagers, and lovers of the sea.

Explore One of Alexandra’s Top Listings – 44′ Monte Carlo Yachts MC5 2016

Charting New Horizons

As Alexandra embarks on this exciting new journey, we invite our friends, clients, and partners to join us in celebrating her story. Her participation in The Golden Bachelor not only highlights her own remarkable path but also underscores FYI Yachts’ presence in the world of luxury, lifestyle, and adventure.

From the decks of the finest yachts to the bright lights of television, Alexandra represents the elegance, vitality, and spirit that define FYI.

WE MAKE YOUR YACHTING DREAMS COME TRUE

✨ Follow along with Alexandra’s journey on ABC’s The Golden Bachelor and continue to discover the world of yachting with FYI Yachts, where luxury lifestyle begins.
